context: Tests whether the agent writes a correct Docusaurus remark plugin following the skill's conventions: proper plugin function signature, unist-util-visit for AST traversal, jsx node type for component injection, init-time data caching, beforeDefaultRemarkPlugins registration, and correct package.json configuration.

checklist.name: Plugin function signature
checklist.description: plugin/index.js exports a function (the plugin factory) that returns another function — the transformer — matching the pattern: module.exports = function(...) { return function transformer(ast, vfile) { ... } }

checklist.name: Async transformer
checklist.description: The inner transformer function is declared as async (async function transformer or async (ast, vfile) =>)

checklist.name: unist-util-visit usage
checklist.description: plugin/index.js requires or imports unist-util-visit and calls visit() to traverse the AST — does NOT use manual tree walking or a different traversal library

checklist.name: jsx node type
checklist.description: The plugin creates a node with type: 'jsx' (not type: 'html', 'paragraph', or any other type) when injecting the GlossaryTerm component

checklist.name: GlossaryTerm component in jsx value
checklist.description: The jsx node's value string contains a <GlossaryTerm ... /> or <GlossaryTerm ...>...</GlossaryTerm> element referencing both the term key and the tooltip text

checklist.name: Init-time data loading
checklist.description: The terms.json file is read (fs.readFileSync or equivalent) OUTSIDE the transformer function body — i.e., at plugin initialisation time, not inside the function that runs per document

checklist.name: unist-util-visit dependency
checklist.description: plugin/package.json lists unist-util-visit in the dependencies field (not devDependencies)

checklist.name: Docusaurus core peer dependency
checklist.description: plugin/package.json lists @docusaurus/core in the peerDependencies field

checklist.name: beforeDefaultRemarkPlugins registration
checklist.description: docusaurus.config.js registers the plugin using beforeDefaultRemarkPlugins (not remarkPlugins)

checklist.name: No extra traversal dependencies
checklist.description: plugin/package.json does NOT list any AST traversal library other than unist-util-visit in dependencies (e.g. no mdast-util-*, unist-util-map, etc.)
